Definition: to be extinguished; figuratively, to expire or be dried up
BiblicalUsage: 1) to go out, be extinguished, dry up; 1a) (Qal) to go out, be extinguished; 1b) (Niphal) to be made extinct, be dried up; 1c) (Pual) to be extinguished, be quenched
